claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu described Taygetan sphere drones as surveillance craft with autonomous AI; they can operate alone and communicate telemetry and video to a crewed mothership.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She described the common sphere as 110 cm wide, with a self-repairing polymorphic titanium shell, crystal-core zero-point reactor, and counter-rotating mercury-based turbines generating a toroidal gravity-distorting field.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: The shell repairs only minor to moderate damage.

claims.assertion: Mari said Taygeta uses three drone sizes, from portable tactical spheres to larger craft; its common model has retractable plasma cannons but mainly monitors.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

coverage_gaps: Crop-circle purposes and claimed starseed monitoring role
